priorityList: Ensure your pet is summoned and use Power Siphon if you have 1 or fewer Demonic Core stacks.
Use offensive trinkets, racials, and potions when Summon Demonic Tyrant is active.
Cast Grimoire: Imp Lord, Grimoire: Fel Ravager, or Summon Doomguard immediately when triggered by Diabolic Ritual.
Cast Ruination as soon as the proc becomes available.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan if the Dominion of Argus buff is active.
Cast Summon Demonic Tyrant when you have 5 Soul Shards.
In AoE (3+ targets), cast Implosion if you have 6 or more Wild Imps active.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan whenever you have 3 or more Soul Shards.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have Demonic Core stacks and fewer than 3 Soul Shards.
Cast Demonbolt if you have Demonic Core stacks and fewer than 4 Soul Shards.
Cast Shadow Bolt as your filler to generate Soul Shards.
